note: ONE registry for kind in {band, policy}. Built-in bands live in entry_lab.bands; research candidates are modules under selfimprove/candidates/ imported ONLY through this list and only after bands.static_ok passes. Entries are never deleted (status 'retired' at most): every registration is a counted trial in selfimprove/trials.json and deflates every later DSR. Controls have status 'control' and are never eligible for promotion.

candidates.name: band_a_strict
candidates.rationale: The default champion: every screen.hc_checks check True (score, exact top-10 and holder count from Blockscout, liquidity, creator prior launches, age >= 90 min, organic holders/min and tx/holder rates, sell round-trip, whitelisted/verified template, LP known, dev holding, not sniped at creation). On solana this strict band was the best of 14 tested and every relaxation was worse; an unknown input is NA, never a silent False.

candidates.name: band_no_age
candidates.rationale: band_a_strict without the age >= 90 min check (holders/min kept). Tests whether the age floor buys survival or only delays entry past the early peak: solana winners peak ~4 h after entry, so an earlier entry could capture more of the move, or more of the rugs.

candidates.name: band_score60
candidates.rationale: band_a_strict with the soft-score floor lowered from HC_MIN_SCORE to BAND_SCORE60_MIN. The soft score was anti-predictive for upside on solana; this measures whether the score floor is doing any work in the strict band or merely shrinking its n.

candidates.name: band_holders500
candidates.rationale: band_a_strict with the exact holder floor lowered to BAND_HOLDERS500_MIN (Blockscout count only, contracts excluded). Robinhood Chain is younger and thinner than solana; a 1000-holder floor may be unreachable inside the 24 h window for most survivors.

candidates.name: band_dev_score_ge70
candidates.rationale: RobinX's free deployer score >= BAND_DEV_SCORE_MIN (their own webhook threshold). A pure deployer-reputation band, kept because the proven-dev hypothesis was retired on evidence (P1 was a look-ahead bug; 27 of 27 $10M deployers were distinct) and this is the cheapest honest way to keep testing 'the dev matters' against a gate-matched control.

candidates.name: band_graduated_only
candidates.rationale: Launchpad graduation completed within BAND_GRADUATED_MAX_AGE_S (GT launchpad_details / Flap progress). The pump.fun-migration analogue: on solana the migration instant was the one structural event every winner shared, and 60% of rugs collapsed < 20 min after it.

candidates.name: band_top10_le15
candidates.rationale: band_a_strict with a tighter top-10 concentration cap (BAND_TOP10_LE15_MAX). Exact Blockscout top-10 when available; GT's snapshot only while younger than BAND_HOLDERS_MAX_STALE_S (GT holder snapshots run 8 min..23 h stale); otherwise NA.

candidates.name: band_lp_burned_renounced
candidates.rationale: Pure chain-truth band: owner renounced, LP burned >= BAND_LP_BURNED_MIN_PCT, sell round-trip <= BAND_ROUND_TRIP_LOSS_MAX_PCT, the three facts read directly by eth_call and never from an aggregator (GoPlus and ScanHood both got MIZUKARA's LP wrong). Tests whether survival is mostly contract hygiene rather than market shape.

candidates.name: ctl_random_band
candidates.rationale: NEGATIVE CONTROL. Selects a sha256-chosen BAND_CTL_RANDOM_RATE share of tokens and fires at a per-token deterministic delay U(0, BAND_WATCH_WINDOW_S), so its firing instants are spread over the window like a maturation band's. Must fail every gate; if it does not, the apparatus is measuring itself.

candidates.name: ctl_inverse_band
candidates.rationale: NEGATIVE CONTROL, audit column only: the champion's complement, computed by runtime.evaluate_bands as (None if champion verdict is None else not champion verdict) and recomputed on the fly by the scorecard. If the inverse beats the champion, the champion is anti-selecting.

candidates.name: band_launchpad_lenient
candidates.rationale: Pre-declared 2026-09-12 from the two reference winners (CATGPT, ANTHROPIG: Bankr/Doppler launches on Uniswap V4). On the launchpad the dev holding, the launcher's prior count and the creation-tx snipe are unanswerable for app/agent-launched tokens, so this band drops exactly those three hc checks THERE and equals band_a_strict everywhere else. Tests whether the strict band's dev/creator checks cost recall on the chain's dominant launchpad.

candidates.name: band_volume_early
candidates.rationale: The operator's thesis, pre-declared 2026-09-12: get in EARLY (pool age <= 30 min, mcap <= $2M) on a coin that already trades heavily (hour-1 volume >= $50k, liq >= $10k) with buyers dominating (buys >= 2x sells). Measured at sighting on the day's 40 survivors: FRONTIER (23x), ROBOJENSEN (3.7x), DEGENFLY (3.3x) all had buys >= 2x sells while every balanced-flow sighting went flat or to zero (n=9, in-sample). A hypothesis the ledger will judge — it is the alerted band by manual --set, and the demotion test reverts it to band_a_strict if the selection lift over the same-day, same-age pool is not positive.
